title: FOCUS: A Lightweight Mamba-2 Model for EEG-Based Cognitive Workload Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.32361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cognitive workload estimation from physiological signals is increasingly relevant in high-risk environments, where continuous and unobtrusive monitoring can inform adaptive systems and safety interventions. This paper presents FOCUS (Frequency-band Optimized Cognitive-load Ultralight SSM), a compact Mamba-2-based model for EEG-based binary workload classification under constrained data conditions. Rather than learning frequency sensitivity from data, FOCUS encodes preprocessed multi-channel EEG using a fixed FFT decomposition that covers the five canonical EEG bands. The proposed model combines depthwise-separable convolution and a weight-shared encoder-bottleneck Mamba-2 pair, with 0.04 million parameters and 0.11 GFLOPs. Evaluated in a pilot study with 11 participants under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation across three cognitively distinct tasks, FOCUS achieves 74.75% accuracy on the full dataset at 0.08 ms GPU model-forward late

translated_title: FOCUS：一种用于基于脑电认知负荷分类的轻量级Mamba-2模型
translated_abstract: 基于生理信号的认知负荷估计在高风险环境中日益重要，在这些环境中，持续且无干扰的监测可以为自适应系统和安全干预提供依据。本文提出了FOCUS（频带优化的认知负荷超轻量状态空间模型），这是一个基于Mamba-2的紧凑模型，用于在数据受限条件下进行基于脑电图的二分类认知负荷分类。FOCUS并非从数据中学习频率敏感性，而是采用覆盖五个经典脑电频带的固定FFT分解对预处理后的多通道脑电信号进行编码。所提出的模型结合了深度可分离卷积和权重共享的编码器-瓶颈式Mamba-2结构，参数量仅为0.04百万（4万），计算量为0.11 GFLOPs。在一项包含11名参与者的初步研究中，通过在三个认知上不同的任务上进行留一被试交叉验证评估，FOCUS在完整数据集上达到了74.75%的准确率，GPU模型前向延迟仅为0.08毫秒。
tldr: 提出了一种仅有4万参数的轻量级Mamba-2模型FOCUS，利用固定FFT五频带分解编码多通道脑电信号，在数据受限条件下实现了高效准确的认知负荷二分类。
